data_facts:
Facts about these data, checked on all 410 stores. The six permanently closed stores (status2 = 3) have recorded zeros for empft2, emppt2 and nmgrs2, so their follow-up employment needs no recoding. All five stores with status2 of 0, 2, 4 or 5 have missing empft2 and emppt2. So these two sample rules select the same 391 stores with the same values, in the full data and in every subset of it: keeping stores with complete full-time and part-time counts in both waves, with no status filter; and keeping stores with status2 of 1 or 3 and complete counts, with closures at zero. Keeping only stores with status2 = 1 selects 385 stores and is a different sample.

Two declared sample rules that select the same stores with the same values in these data are the same restriction, however they are worded. Rules that select different stores remain different restrictions.

target_declaration.model: The model compares mean within-store employment changes between New Jersey and Pennsylvania. The estimand is the New Jersey population mean change minus the Pennsylvania population mean change. Stores are treated as independent, and change variances may differ between states; no observation distribution or known population variance was specified. The within-store change accounts for each store's baseline employment. State is the comparison variable, and no additional covariates are included. Part-time employees are assigned a fixed weight of 0.5, and permanently closed stores are assigned zero follow-up employment.
target_declaration.null: The mean change in non-manager full-time-equivalent employment is the same in New Jersey and Pennsylvania: the New Jersey mean change minus the Pennsylvania mean change equals zero.
target_declaration.population: Stores from Burger King, KFC, Roy Rogers, and Wendy's in New Jersey and eastern Pennsylvania covered by the two-wave survey frame.
target_declaration.outcome: Store-level change from before to after the increase in non-manager full-time-equivalent employment, defined at each wave as the number of full-time employees plus 0.5 times the number of part-time employees. Follow-up employment is set to zero for permanently closed stores.
target_declaration.sample_restrictions: Beyond the supplied survey frame, the analysis includes stores coded as New Jersey or Pennsylvania whose follow-up status is interviewed or permanently closed. It requires finite baseline full-time and part-time employee counts and, for interviewed stores, finite follow-up counts for both components. Refusals, temporary closures, other or missing follow-up statuses, and stores missing the required employment components are excluded.

public_context.name: DESIGN.md
public_context.text:
# Survey setting

New Jersey increased its hourly minimum wage from $4.25 to $5.05 on April 1, 1992. Pennsylvania's minimum wage remained unchanged.
The survey frame covers stores from four fast-food chains in New Jersey and eastern Pennsylvania: Burger King, KFC, Roy Rogers and Wendy's.
The first wave was collected before the increase, in February and March 1992. The second wave was collected in November and December 1992.
Each row holds both waves for one store, including any missing fields and follow-up status. Supplied subsets retain the same underlying store frame and geographic, chain and survey-wave definitions.

# Store survey variables

Each row contains both survey waves for one store.
Missing source entries are represented by NA. Raw employee counts and closure status codes are retained without recoding.
store_id combines state and sheet with a space; sheet alone is not unique across states.

| Variable | Meaning |
|---|---|
| sheet | Original survey sheet number; not unique across states. |
| chain | Restaurant chain: 1 Burger King; 2 KFC; 3 Roy Rogers; 4 Wendy's. |
| co_owned | Company-owned store indicator (1 yes, 0 no). |
| state | State: 1 New Jersey; 0 Pennsylvania. |
| southj | Southern New Jersey indicator. |
| centralj | Central New Jersey indicator. |
| northj | Northern New Jersey indicator. |
| pa1 | Northeastern Philadelphia suburbs indicator. |
| pa2 | Easton and nearby Pennsylvania area indicator. |
| shore | New Jersey shore location indicator. |
| ncalls | Wave 1 call-backs; zero means contact on first call. |
| empft | Wave 1 number of full-time employees, excluding managers and assistant managers. |
| emppt | Wave 1 number of part-time employees, excluding managers and assistant managers. |
| nmgrs | Wave 1 number of managers and assistant managers. |
| wage_st | Wave 1 starting wage, dollars per hour. |
| inctime | Wave 1 months to the usual first raise. |
| firstinc | Wave 1 usual first raise, dollars per hour. |
| bonus | Wave 1 cash bounty for new workers indicator. |
| pctaff | Wave 1 percent of employees affected by the new minimum wage. |
| meals | Wave 1 employee meal benefit code. |
| open | Wave 1 opening hour. |
| hrsopen | Wave 1 hours open per day. |
| psoda | Wave 1 medium soda price including tax, dollars. |
| pfry | Wave 1 small fries price including tax, dollars. |
| pentree | Wave 1 entree price including tax, dollars. |
| nregs | Wave 1 number of cash registers. |
| nregs11 | Wave 1 number of registers open at 11 am. |
| type2 | Wave 2 interview type: 1 phone; 2 in person. |
| status2 | Wave 2 interview/store status; codes below. |
| date2 | Wave 2 interview date in numeric MMDDYY format. |
| ncalls2 | Wave 2 call-backs; zero means contact on first call. |
| empft2 | Wave 2 number of full-time employees, excluding managers and assistant managers. |
| emppt2 | Wave 2 number of part-time employees, excluding managers and assistant managers. |
| nmgrs2 | Wave 2 number of managers and assistant managers. |
| wage_st2 | Wave 2 starting wage, dollars per hour. |
| inctime2 | Wave 2 months to the usual first raise. |
| firstin2 | Wave 2 usual first raise, dollars per hour. |
| special2 | Wave 2 special program for new workers indicator. |
| meals2 | Wave 2 employee meal benefit code. |
| open2r | Wave 2 opening hour. |
| hrsopen2 | Wave 2 hours open per day. |
| psoda2 | Wave 2 medium soda price including tax, dollars. |
| pfry2 | Wave 2 small fries price including tax, dollars. |
| pentree2 | Wave 2 entree price including tax, dollars. |
| nregs2 | Wave 2 number of cash registers. |
| nregs112 | Wave 2 number of registers open at 11 am. |

Meal codes (meals, meals2): 0 none; 1 free meals; 2 reduced-price meals; 3 both.
Status codes (status2): 0 refused wave 2; 1 answered wave 2; 2 closed for renovations; 3 permanently closed; 4 closed for highway construction; 5 closed due to a mall fire.
